notes.title: New Gameplay Video 🎮✨
notes.content: [p]I’ve been working on a new gameplay video after receiving a lot of honest and constructive feedback from you. Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughts, it really helps me improve.[/p][p align="start"]It’s always a challenge (but also super exciting!) to take all my ideas and turn them into a short video that makes sense for someone seeing the game for the very first time. When you’re so deep into development, it’s easy to forget what feels clear and what doesn’t.[/p][p align="start"]I’m really enjoying the process, and I truly hope you like this new video. Your feedback means a lot, so please let me know what you think, every comment helps me shape [i]Escape the Baby Alarm[/i] into the best version it can be. 💛[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="HXbVKr9RkZ8;full"][/previewyoutube]
